question: From the first year each actor appeared in a film to the last, how many actors in the database never had a gap longer than three consecutive years without at least one new movie appearance, meaning there is no four-year span anywhere in their active career without at least a single film credit?
sql:
WITH actor_years AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    mc.PID,
    TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) AS yr
  FROM M_Cast mc
  JOIN Movie m ON mc.MID = m.MID
  WHERE TRY_CAST(SPLIT_PART(m.year, ' ', -1) AS INTEGER) IS NOT NULL
),
actor_year_range AS (
  SELECT 
    PID,
    MIN(yr) AS first_year,
    MAX(yr) AS last_year
  FROM actor_years
  GROUP BY PID
),
actor_year_presence AS (
  SELECT 
    ay.PID,
    ay.yr
  FROM actor_years ay
  JOIN actor_year_range ay2 ON ay.PID = ay2.PID
  WHERE ay.yr BETWEEN ay2.first_year AND ay2.last_year
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT 
    PID,
    yr,
    LEAD(yr) OVER (PARTITION BY PID ORDER BY yr) AS next_yr
  FROM actor_year_presence
),
actors_with_4yr_gap AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT PID
  FROM gaps
  WHERE next_yr - yr >= 5
)
SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT PID) FROM actor_year_range) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM actors_with_4yr_gap) AS result
